ext_description.message: Check one image for AI-provenance signals (Content Credentials, metadata) on request. Nothing is scanned automatically.

options_key_saved.message: A key is saved. It is never shown again, not even to you.

options_advice.message: Use a dedicated project key with a spend limit of its own.

options_test_note.message: Sends one bundled sample image to OpenAI, never your own image or the image you checked. Checks are currently free, but rate limits are strict.

options_privacy.message: Local checks (Content Credentials and image metadata) run on this machine and are never uploaded. An OpenAI check runs only after you confirm it in a separate window, which sends that image to OpenAI; OpenAI states that uploaded content is not stored unless legally required and is not used to train models. Checks are currently free, but rate limits are strict. No other requests are made.

error_openai_no_key.message: No API key is saved, so nothing was uploaded.

error_openai_invalid_key.message: The saved key cannot be used as a request header. Save it again.

error_openai_check_expired.message: The check expired. Check the image again.

error_openai_hash_mismatch.message: The image changed since it was checked, so nothing was uploaded.

error_openai_unsupported_type.message: OpenAI does not accept this image type.

error_openai_fetch_failed.message: The image could not be downloaded.

error_openai_http_400.message: OpenAI rejected the file (400). It may be unsupported or too large.

error_openai_http_401.message: The API key was rejected (401). Check the key and save it again.

error_openai_http_404.message: This OpenAI organisation does not have access to the check (404).

error_openai_http_5xx.message: OpenAI reported a server error. Try again later.

error_openai_rate_limited.message: OpenAI rate limit reached. Try again later.

error_openai_rate_limited_after.message: OpenAI rate limit reached. Try again in $1 seconds.

error_openai_unusable_reply.message: The extension did not get a usable reply from its own worker. Reload the extension.

confirm_body.message: This image will be sent to OpenAI to check for provenance signals. Checks are currently free, but strict rate limits apply.

confirm_converted.message: OpenAI does not accept this format. The server's converted copy of the image will be downloaded again and sent instead; it may differ from the one you checked.

popup_caveat_no_signal.message: No signal does not mean the image is human-made.

error_permission_denied.message: Access to the image was not allowed.

error_fetch_failed.message: The image could not be downloaded.

error_timeout.message: Downloading the image took too long.

error_too_large.message: The image is too large to check.

error_unsupported_type.message: This image type is not supported.

popup_detail_incomplete.message: The image could not be fully checked, so no result can be given.

popup_c2pa_present_ai.message: Present and claims an AI-generated image.

popup_c2pa_present_other.message: Present, but the claim is not about AI generation.

popup_c2pa_unverified.message: Present but did not verify; the image may have been edited.

popup_c2pa_profile.message: The signature matches the file, but the signer certificate is not in the C2PA profile.

popup_c2pa_error.message: The Content Credentials could not be read.

popup_xmp_error.message: The metadata could not be read.

popup_synthid_converted.message: OpenAI received a copy the server converted; converting can remove signals.

popup_openai_c2pa_detected.message: A Content Credentials manifest was found, with an AI signal.

popup_openai_c2pa_described.message: A Content Credentials manifest was found, but with no AI signal.

popup_button_no_key.message: No API key saved. Add one in the extension's options.

toast_no_signal.message: No AI signal found. This does not prove the image is human-made.
